title: Data Privacy and Security Policy
content:
Document ID:

POL-DATA-002

Effective Date:

March 15, 2025

1. Objective To ensure customer and company data is handled safely and legally.
2. Data Classification All company data is classified into two categories:
3. Public: Information freely available to anyone (e.g., marketing materials).
4. Confidential: Customer data, employee records, and financial data.

title: Data Protection Rules
content:
- Confidential data must not be sent to personal email addresses.
- Databases containing customer information should be encrypted.
- Employees working remotely must use the company VPN to access confidential files.
